name: Dere Quintet
source:
High school times – happy times. At least that was your first two years at "Sakura High", but then, that fateful morning, everything changed...

Classes were reshuffled and you ended up in that class. The one with the Ice Queen, the Biting Beauty and the Girl of Doom... and on top of that, it's the home base of the Secret Sakura Society – a school club that has the noble goal of matchmaking every single student at Sakura High (whether they want it or not).

Will you survive this year full of challenges? Will you make new friends? Or even find love?

Your little sister supports you wholeheartedly (whether you want it or not...)

And then there's the other side... You can also play as "Ship-kun", the always loyal boyfriend of Deguchi Dekiko, president of the Secret Sakura Society. Will you succeed to matchmake every single student? Her eternal love will be yours!

This romantic comedy that is as serious as cotton candy will entertain you for a few stress-free hours that you'll never forget...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4776130/Dere_Quintet/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
高中时代——快乐的时光。至少那是你在“樱花高中”的头两年，但后来，那个决定性的早晨，一切都改变了……

班级重新洗牌，你最终进入了那个班级。这里有冰雪女王、咬人美女和末日少女……最重要的是，它是秘密樱花社的大本营——一个学校俱乐部，其崇高目标是为樱花高中的每一位学生牵线搭桥（无论他们愿意与否）。

你能度过充满挑战的这一年吗？你会结交新朋友吗？或者甚至找到爱情？

你的妹妹全心全意支持你（不管你愿不愿意……）还有另一面……你还可以扮演“Ship-kun”，秘密樱花会会长Deguchi Dekiko永远忠诚的男友。你能成功为每一个学生配对吗？她永恒的爱将属于你！

这部像棉花糖一样严肃的浪漫喜剧将让你度过几个难忘的无压力小时……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4776130/Dere_Quintet/]Steam[/url]]
